scientific_truth: Carson said, "I didn’t have an involvement with" the nutritional supplement company Mannatech. As far as we can tell, Carson was not a paid employee or official endorser of the product. However, his claim suggests he has no ties to Mannatech whatsoever.

claim_subject: The city of Lake Worth Beach, Florida cut power and water services to some residents in the middle of the COVID-19 pandemic.
scientific_truth: Did a Florida City Cut Residents’ Power During the COVID-19 Pandemic?

claim_subject: Hate daylight saving time? You may have a point, researchers say.
scientific_truth: For most Americans, daylight saving time means only one thing: losing an hour’s sleep. So what is the point?

claim_subject: Novartis's new treatment for hives outperforms Xolair in trials.
scientific_truth: Novartis said on Tuesday it was taking its experimental medicine ligelizumab to late-stage trials after the drug showed signs of outperforming existing product Xolair in treating severe urticaria, also known as hives.

claim_subject: Although Georgia Gov. Brian Kemp "opened" the state, his mansion remained closed for tours during the COVID-19 pandemic.
scientific_truth: Is the Georgia Governor’s Mansion Closed Due to COVID-19, Despite Its Governor ‘Opening’ the State for Business?

claim_subject: Test may help predict colon cancer recurrence risk
scientific_truth: Whether to give chemotherapy after surgery for localized colon cancer is controversial. Chemotherapy has significant side effects and the survival benefit is small. As is currently done for breast cancer, to be able to predict whether the tumor is likely to return after surgery would help guide treatment decisions about chemotherapy.

claim_subject: Indonesian doctor's death exposes heartbreaking risks of coronavirus battle.
scientific_truth: When Indonesian doctor Ratih Purwarini was buried at dusk in a Jakarta cemetery, only her son Firos saw her plastic-wrapped coffin used for coronavirus victims lowered into the grave.

claim_subject: Thailand closes more public facilities as coronavirus cases top 1,100.
scientific_truth: The Thai government on Friday ordered the closing down of more public facilities and businesses in a bid to curb the spread of coronavirus, and extended existing closures until the end of April.

claim_subject: Compound May Fight Hard-to-Treat Lung Cancer
scientific_truth: It took until 268 words deep into a 383 word story to learn that the "Compound May Fight Hard-to-Treat Lung Cancer" story was not about human research. This article commits one of the cardinal sins of health journalism: it downplays the fact that the research was not done in humans.

claim_subject: Kentucky reports 4 adults have died of the flu this season.
scientific_truth: Kentucky health officials say four people have died of the flu this season.

claim_subject: Minnesota bets fiscal future on osteopathic medical school.
scientific_truth: In December of 2014, Gaylord banker Philip Keithahn met with six leaders in this small Sibley County town to discuss an audacious question. A month earlier, voters in the Sibley East Public Schools district had agreed to build a new elementary school in Gaylord, a decision that would eventually leave the existing school sitting abandoned a few blocks from downtown.

claim_subject: Event 201 “gave out stuffed souvenir coronavirus toys” to “commemorate” Novel coronavirus outbreak
scientific_truth: The toy at the center of the controversy is supposed to be a coronavirus microbe. Event 201 offered the plushies to people who registered to attend an October 2019 gathering that was designed to help plan for a global pandemic by bringing together business, government, and public health leaders.

claim_subject: Health officials have seen a surge in the number of people using "bug spray" to get high.
scientific_truth: There are two cases, though only one has been confirmed, in which a crystallized form of bug spray is alleged to have been added to methamphetamine, and these events resulted in symptoms consistent with an aggressive methamphetamine high.

claim_subject: Drinking one diet drink a day triples a person's risk of dementia and strokes.
scientific_truth: Some studies show an association between increased consumption of artificially sweetened beverages and stroke or dementia risk, but that does not mean one causes the other.

claim_subject: Aveo Oncology to end breast cancer study due to low enrollment.
scientific_truth: Aveo Oncology said it would end a mid-stage trial testing its lead drug as a treatment for breast cancer, as the company did not have enough patients enrolled in the study.

claim_subject: North Carolina fair bans mist fans as health measure.
scientific_truth: A North Carolina fair is banning the use of hand-held mist fans to guard against an outbreak of Legionnaires’ disease like the one that happened at another fair last month.

claim_subject: A daily regimen of ingesting gin-soaked raisins will help relieve arthritis symptoms.
scientific_truth: Gin has been featured in non-raisin arthritis cures, including one that made the news in Baltimore in 1956. In that incident, an elderly Chinese man was bitten by one of the seven rattlesnakes he’d purchased for the purpose of creating an arthritis cure that involved pickling the serpents in gin for a year.

claim_subject: The GOP health bill "would once again allow being a rape or domestic violence victim to be a pre-existing condition.
scientific_truth: Various bloggers, and some members of Congress, wrote that under the House Republican health plan, sexual assault and domestic violence is a pre-existing condition. Several websites have since softened their headlines to be more careful, going from "would" to "could.

claim_subject: Within the three miles surrounding the University Circle area, infant mortality exceeds some Third World countries.
scientific_truth: Expert says infant mortality rate near University Circle exceeds that of some Third World countries

claim_subject: “The flu killed 80,000 people in the U.S. last year”
scientific_truth: The CDC’s estimate for seasonal flu deaths for the 2017-18 season was about 61,000. The CDC’s preliminary estimate for seasonal flu deaths for the 2018-19 season is about 34,200, but that’s not the final number.

claim_subject: Trio wins chemistry Nobel for work on antibody drugs, smart enzymes.
scientific_truth: Two Americans and a Briton won the 2018 Nobel Prize for Chemistry on Wednesday for harnessing the power of evolution to generate novel proteins used in everything from environmentally friendly detergents to cancer drugs.

claim_subject: UCB urges stronger warning on cough medicine.
scientific_truth: Belgian pharmaceutical group UCB SA has proposed a stronger warning for its prescription cough medicine Tussionex following reports that five young children died, a company spokesman said on Friday.

claim_subject: Oregon Health Authority Says that in 2007, "Oregon ranked 25th -- or 7th from the bottom -- in percentage of children with untreated decay compared to 32 other states with similar data.
scientific_truth: Did Oregon rank No. 25 of 32 states in untreated decay in 2007?

claim_subject: California rejects unique intersex surgery ban for some kids.
scientific_truth: California lawmakers have rejected what would have been a first-of-its-kind ban on medically unnecessary treatment for infants born with ambiguous or conflicting genitalia.

claim_subject: Princeton revising polices over mental health disabilities.
scientific_truth: Federal law enforcement officials have reached an agreement with Princeton University to resolve concerns about the school’s treatment of students with mental health disabilities.

claim_subject: Clout-chasing teenagers are participating in the "coronavirus challenge" on TikTok, Instagram, and other social media platforms, sharing attempts to infect themselves and contract COVID-19.
scientific_truth: Is a ‘Coronavirus Challenge’ on Social Media Prompting Teens to Infect Themselves With COVID-19?

claim_subject: According to (Barack) Obama’s newest unconstitutionally enacted law, health care professionals are now required to violate HIPAA privacy laws and submit medical data to the government," which is "then used as justification for gun confiscation.
scientific_truth: The post we’re checking said that, "according to (Barack) Obama’s newest unconstitutionally enacted law, health care professionals are now required to violate HIPAA privacy laws and submit medical data to the government," which is "then used as justification for gun confiscation." The elements of this claim range from misleading to flat-out wrong.

claim_subject: Mike Coffman Says state Sen. Morgan Carroll's votes made "it easier to sue doctors, small businesses, even nurses. Putting her own shady interests first.
scientific_truth: Coffman says Carroll’s votes on state legislation made "it easier to sue doctors, small businesses, even nurses. Putting her own shady interests first." Carroll voted in committee against a bill to grant immunity from civil liability to doctors, nurses and other medical professionals who volunteer at free medical clinics.

claim_subject: Polysorbate 80 and 20 are in vaccines and cause cancer in animals and are linked to autoimmune issues and infertility.
scientific_truth: Tiny amounts of Polysorbate 80 is in a type of flu vaccine. There isn’t evidence ingesting it is linked to these issues in humans.

claim_subject: Baby illness can be scanned in mother's blood: study.
scientific_truth: Parents may soon be able to find out if their unborn child is prone to any inherited diseases, researchers said on Thursday, after developing a non-invasive technique to draw the entire gene map of the human fetus.

claim_subject: Facebook post Says Anthony Fauci, Bill Gates, George Soros and Jeffrey Epstein are connected with Moderna, Inc., and its efforts to create the coronavirus vaccine.
scientific_truth: The connections the post claims are wrong. Fauci is more than 14 years older than Gates and had already graduated from Cornell and was working at the NIH when Gates was in college. Gates did not attend Cornell and did not room with Fauci. IG Farben is not connected to Moderna. Fauci was never CEO of Moderna.

claim_subject: Studies have demonstrated that cooking with aluminum foil can result in the ingestion of aluminum, which is a risk factor for Alzheimer's disease.
scientific_truth: More recent studies have come to light that may end up reinvigorating the debate, but both the connection of aluminum to Alzheimer’s and its mechanism for causing the disease are far from settled science. That being said, it’s incredibly unlikely you are exposing your brain to high concentrations of aluminum by cooking with aluminum foil in the first place.

claim_subject: Philippines to cull 200,000 fowl after bird flu outbreak.
scientific_truth: The Philippines will cull at least 200,000 birds after confirming its first avian flu outbreak, but no animal-to-human transmission has been reported, officials said Friday.

claim_subject: France struggling to curb rate of coronavirus pandemic, health official says.
scientific_truth: France is struggling to curb the spread of the coronavirus pandemic in the country, its top health official Jerome Salomon said on Monday, as authorities consider whether to implement a partial lockdown.

claim_subject: Dominican hospital under scrutiny after 14 newborns die.
scientific_truth: A medical association in the Dominican Republic on Wednesday demanded improvements at one of the country’s main public hospitals, where at least 14 newborns died over the weekend.

claim_subject: US experts reviewing low-carb, other diets for guidelines.
scientific_truth: With keto-friendly recipes sweeping social media, some followers of low-carb eating are hoping for a nod of approval in the upcoming U.S. dietary guidelines that advise Americans on what to eat.

claim_subject: Missouri physicians warn against bug-borne diseases.
scientific_truth: Missouri residents should be on the lookout for diseases caused by mosquito, flea and tick bites, according to a recent report.

claim_subject: United States health care facilities face an intravenous bag shortage because of the devastation wreaked by Hurricane Maria in September 2017.
scientific_truth: Most of the people who have contacted him since his remark began spreading online, he said, have offered similar stories.

claim_subject: Wisconsin bill "grants drug companies and medical device manufacturers immunity from injuries and deaths caused by their products.
scientific_truth: Health care advocate says Wisconsin bill would give drug makers immunity from lawsuits over injury or death

claim_subject: Nursing home with most virus deaths fined $10K a day.
scientific_truth: Regulators in Maryland will fine a nursing home that has had the most virus-related deaths in the state $10,000 a day.

claim_subject: The Cutting Edge: Robotic Surgery, Today!
scientific_truth: Let’s start by saying there is nothing inherently wrong with a gee-whiz TV segment that does a live demo of cool new medical technologies. In a perfect world the segment would be coherent and would feel apropos of something, but even that is not essential. Television is an ideal medium for this kind of demonstration.

claim_subject: “Only 6% of the people actually died from COVID.” The others “died from other reasons.”
scientific_truth: In an interview with Fox News’ Laura Ingraham, Trump misconstrued data on coronavirus deaths. As of Sept. 3, 185,092 Americans had died due to COVID-19. A CDC report found that 6% of people who died from COVID-19 only had the virus. The majority had other conditions as well, but that doesn’t mean COVID-19 wasn’t to blame.

claim_subject: Facebook post Says a warning label on a box of disposable masks shows that they are ineffective at protecting against the spread of COVID-19.
scientific_truth: The N95 respirator offers the most protection against viral particles for the wearer because it can filter very small aerosol particles. But other masks, like the ones in the photo or homemade fabric masks, are effective in reducing the spread of the disease because they help stop asymptomatic individuals from unknowingly spreading the disease.

claim_subject: Provenge vaccine prolongs life in prostate cancer patients
scientific_truth: This story provides many of the key details readers need to understand the results of the trial of Provenge – being evaluated as a treatment for advanced prostate cancer – but the overall tone of the story emphasizes the good news while soft-peddling the caveats.

claim_subject: Spanking kids can cause long-term harm: Canada study.
scientific_truth: Spanking children can cause long-term developmental damage and may even lower a child’s IQ, according to a new Canadian analysis that seeks to shift the ethical debate over corporal punishment into the medical sphere.

claim_subject: Bats are pictured on the reverse of a U.S. quarter issued in 2020, an indicator that COVID-19 is connected to a government plot.
scientific_truth: Australian Prime Minister Scott Morrison issued a rare public apology on Friday and cut short a Hawaiian vacation in response to mounting public anger after two volunteer firefighters were killed battling bushfires sweeping the country’s east coast.

claim_subject: New adult behavioral health unit opens in northern Arkansas.
scientific_truth: The discussion of “mental health” seems to be a regular topic in the news these days.

claim_subject: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention is ordering that all deaths no matter the cause be counted as COVID-19 deaths via a new ICD code.
scientific_truth: Did the CDC Order All Deaths Be Recorded as a Result of COVID-19 — Even Heart Attacks and Accidents?

claim_subject: U.S. President Donald Trump referred to the new coronavirus as a "hoax.
scientific_truth: What's true: During a Feb. 28, 2020, campaign rally in South Carolina, President Donald Trump likened the Democrats' criticism of his administration's response to the new coronavirus outbreak to their efforts to impeach him, saying "this is their new hoax." During the speech he also seemed to downplay the severity of the outbreak, comparing it to the common flu.

claim_subject: Foster care, mental health, guns on DeWine’s 2020 agenda.
scientific_truth: Ohio Gov. Mike DeWine will soon propose “rather dramatic changes” to the foster care system and significant additional investment in mental health programs, he said Friday.

claim_subject: 11-year-old shares her story battling cancer with classmates.
scientific_truth: Sophia Stewart can describe her journey from cancer to wellness through bead necklaces.

claim_subject: Colonoscopies Miss Many Cancers, Study Finds
scientific_truth: Screening has been proven to reduce the risk of death from colorectal cancer. Yet fewer than 50% of people get screened, lagging behind other cancer screening tests such as mammography and PSA testing. Colonoscopy is considered the reference standard against which other colorectal cancer screening tests are measured, however, it is not perfect.

claim_subject: UK authorities release confiscated cannabis after boy hospitalized.
scientific_truth: Britain’s interior minister used an exceptional power on Saturday to release medicinal cannabis oil that had been confiscated from an epileptic boy who was later hospitalized suffering from seizures.

claim_subject: U.S. President Donald Trump cut funding for the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC).
scientific_truth: What's true: The Trump administration's proposed 2021 budget includes cuts to the CDC's activities related to chronic disease. What's false: Congress hasn't approved the budget, so CDC funding in 2021 remains unclear.

claim_subject: Probe into fatal Australia bushfire plane crash complicated by dangers.
scientific_truth: Australian officials were working on Friday to extricate the bodies of three U.S. firefighters from a plane that crashed in remote bushland, as the area’s “active” bushfire status complicated an investigation into the accident.

claim_subject: Health officials report third vaping-related death in Texas .
scientific_truth: A woman has become the third person in Texas to die from a lung disease associated with a national outbreak of vaping-related illnesses, according to health officials.

claim_subject: Massachusetts Senate to debate prescription drug price bill.
scientific_truth: The Massachusetts Senate is set to debate legislation that Democratic leaders say will address the soaring cost of prescription drugs.

claim_subject: In 2010 alone, 1,270 infants were reported to have died following attempted abortions and notably that is only one year.
scientific_truth: Yoest said 1,270 infants in 2010 "were reported to have died following attempted abortions." The figure is based on an "other" category of perinatal deaths, but it does not mean what she says it means. Included in this category are babies who die of various other issues, mainly heart problems.

claim_subject: Americans pay 25 percent of their pay for "employer provided" health insurance — which they prefer — whereas people in the UK pay £10 per check for NHS coverage.
scientific_truth: Does the UK’s National Health Service Cost £10 a Month vs $2,500 For American Insurance?

claim_subject: India allows limited exports of anti-malaria drug after Trump warns of retaliation.
scientific_truth: India, the world’s main supplier of generic drugs, said on Tuesday it will allow limited exports of the anti-malaria drug hydroxychloroquine that U.S. President Donald Trump has touted as a potential weapon in the fight against the coronavirus.

claim_subject: “if your child gets this virus their going to hospital alone in a van with people they don’t know...to be with people they don’t know… you will be at home without them in their time of need.”
scientific_truth: It’s illegal to treat a minor without parental consent in the U.S. Even as hospitals are limiting visitors, minors will always be allowed to have one guardian present.

claim_subject: Italy has concluded Covid-19 is not a virus, and people are actually dying of amplified global 5G electromagnetic radiation poisoning.
scientific_truth: Incorrect. Covid-19 is caused by a virus, called SARS-CoV-2, not 5G.

claim_subject: Rick Perry Says he "got lobbied" by a woman with late-stage cancer about vaccinating Texas girls against a virus that can cause cervical cancer.
scientific_truth: : Perry had an ally in Heather Burcham in 2007, but only after he issued his order. In the debate, in contrast, Perry brought up Burcham’s heartfelt advocacy while not speaking to criticism he had been lobbied into the order by a former aide representing a drug company.

claim_subject: Greece quarantines second migrant camp after COVID-19 case confirmed.
scientific_truth: Greece has quarantined a second migrant facility on its mainland after a 53-year-old man tested positive for the new coronavirus, the migration ministry said on Sunday.

claim_subject: US patent number CA2741523 is for swine flu.
scientific_truth: This is the application number for a patent for the Ebola virus made to the Canadian Intellectual Property Office. This patent has not been granted, and doesn’t mean the Ebola virus was created by someone.

claim_subject: Bill McCollum holds the same position on (embryonic stem cell research) as Barack Obama.
scientific_truth: Bill McCollum and Barack Obama see eye-to-eye on stem cell research, Rick Scott claims

claim_subject: After prohibition ended, police deaths didn't reach 200 a year again until the year Nixon declared war on drugs.
scientific_truth: A viral image making the rounds on 4/20 compared the number of police officer deaths during Prohibition to the drug war: "After prohibition ended, police deaths didn't reach 200 a year again until the year Nixon declared war on drugs," the image said. Those numbers aren’t totally accurate, and the comparison itself is misleading.

claim_subject: Texas IDs cancer cluster in polluted Houston neighborhood.
scientific_truth: Texas health officials identified a cancer cluster in a north Houston neighborhood polluted by the wood preservative creosote from a nearby railroad operation, prompting calls from residents and the city for a more in-depth investigation of potential ongoing risks.

claim_subject: Canada faces 'critical week' in coronavirus crisis, death toll jumps.
scientific_truth: Canada faces “a critical week” in fighting the coronavirus, a senior official said on Thursday, as the death toll jumped and the most populous province said residents should brace for a stark scenario.

claim_subject: An amendment inserted by lawmakers into the state budget "exempts scientific researchers from all state animal cruelty laws.
scientific_truth: Wisconsin Humane Society says state budget amendment exempts scientific researchers from state criminal law on animal cruelty

claim_subject: Shots for food workers urged in 2 West Virginia counties.
scientific_truth: Health officials are urging hepatitis A vaccinations for restaurant and food service employees in two West Virginia counties.

claim_subject: Georgia shelter quarantines dog area for parvovirus.
scientific_truth: The dog area of a Georgia animal shelter is under quarantine after three puppies tested positive for the highly contagious canine parvovirus.

claim_subject: Arkansas Colleges of Health Education celebrates 5 years.
scientific_truth: Happy Birthday to the Arkansas Colleges of Health Education.

claim_subject: Death is listed as a side effect of the MMR vaccine.
scientific_truth: Incorrect. The US MMR vaccine package insert, under “adverse reactions”, says death from various and sometimes unknown causes has been reported after vaccination but a causal relationship hasn’t been found in healthy individuals. Death isn’t listed under adverse reactions on either MMR vaccine used in the UK.

claim_subject: According to an unnamed critical care physician working in Italy, emergency rooms in the country were running at 200 percent capacity because of a novel coronavirus.
scientific_truth: Unsourced ‘Intensivist’ Thread Spreads on Twitter as COVID-19 Hits Italy

claim_subject: Jury clears J&J of liability in California talc cancer case.
scientific_truth: A California jury on Wednesday cleared Johnson & Johnson (JNJ.N) of liability in a case involving a woman who alleged that the company’s talc-based products, including its baby powder, contain asbestos and caused her cancer, the company said.

claim_subject: Several emails circulating about the Obama administration’s proposed Universal Health Care bill. One concern is that the passage of this bill will levy an additional capital gains tax on the sales of homes of 3.8%.
scientific_truth: Various emails about the proposed Health Care Bill

claim_subject: The University of Louisville Hospital confirmed the deaths of 16 people from a rare strain of the "HR3211 virus.
scientific_truth: We searched in vain for evidence that an “HR3211 virus” exists (or that any other viruses with medical names beginning with “HR” exist). No legitimate media sources have reported that a viral epidemic killed 16 people in Louisville.

claim_subject: As the United States government tried to negotiate a response to a novel coronavirus strain, cost issues temporarily stalled passing a bill approving roughly $8 billion in emergency funding.
scientific_truth: Was a Coronavirus Bill Stalled Because of Arguments Over How Much to Charge for Vaccines?

claim_subject: Pfizer pulls Lipitor ads with heart expert Jarvik.
scientific_truth: Pfizer Inc said on Monday it was voluntarily withdrawing advertising for its Lipitor cholesterol drug featuring Dr. Robert Jarvik, inventor of the Jarvik artificial heart, because its ads led to “misimpressions.”

claim_subject: U.S. men less likely to heed health warnings as coronavirus death toll mounts: Reuters Poll.
scientific_truth: As America converts itself into a nation of shut-ins, one group appears to be less interested than others in following the ever-lengthening list of health tips aimed at slowing the spread of the coronavirus pandemic: men.

claim_subject: Complacency a concern as AIDS treatment improves in Africa.
scientific_truth: AIDS has no cure. HIV is still here. But some people are forgetting that.

claim_subject: Data suggests opioid-related overdose deaths in Alaska down.
scientific_truth: Preliminary numbers released by the state indicate the number of opioid-related overdose deaths in Alaska fell between 2017 and 2018.

claim_subject: Lose weight with skin cream? Fat chance, says U.S. govt.
scientific_truth: Americans putting their faith in miracle cures to shed unwanted pounds are likely to be disappointed, U.S. regulators said on Tuesday in announcing settlements with four firms accused of falsely advertising weight-loss products such as skin creams.

claim_subject: Hal Turner Radio Show Says the coronavirus is “a MILITARY BIO-WEAPON Developed by China's Army.”
scientific_truth: There is no evidence that the Chinese military developed the 2019 coronavirus as a bioweapon. There are dozens of viruses in a national database with genetic material similar to the coronavirus. Officials are still working to determine the source of the outbreak.

claim_subject: The U.S. State Department has ordered 160,000 Hazmat suits for Ebola, prompting concerns that the federal government is anticipating the rapid spread" of the virus.
scientific_truth: The website InfoWars claimed that the State Department "has ordered 160,000 Hazmat suits for Ebola," demonstrating that "the federal government is anticipating the rapid spread of a virus that has already claimed an unprecedented number of lives." The federal government agency in question is USAID, but that’s something of a technicality.

claim_subject: Gov. Kelly: Kansas psychiatric hospital unit needs changes.
scientific_truth: Kansas Gov. Laura Kelly says a troubled unit within a state hospital for the mentally ill is “not a therapeutic environment” and promised changes.

claim_subject: A form of strep infection is capable of affecting the nasal cavity and face.
scientific_truth: In the case of the Idaho family, iGAS was diagnosed in time, and the pictured boy was reportedly recovering well.

claim_subject: Image of an anti-Semitic sign ("the real plague") was captured at a COVID-19 anti-lockdown protest in Ohio in April 2020.
scientific_truth: ‘The Real Plague’ Anti-Semitic Sign Spotted at Ohio Anti-Lockdown COVID-19 Pandemic Protest

claim_subject: Chris Sununu Says drug dealers have "overdosed on purpose" to avoid prosecution.
scientific_truth: How did a piece of piping installed when Richard Nixon was U.S. president go without once being checked before leading to a fire that devastated the East Coast’s largest and oldest oil refinery?

claim_subject: Image of a COVID-19 anti-lockdown protester's sign calling to re-open "Pennslvania" and referencing "we the peaple" is not doctored or altered in any way.
scientific_truth: Misspelled ‘We the Peaple, Re-Open Pennslvania’ Sign

claim_subject: “Smoking in cars with children is illegal starting January 30, 2018.”
scientific_truth: Q: Did a law go into effect Jan. 30 banning “anyone” from smoking in a car “as long as there are children in the vehicle”?A: No. There is no federal prohibition, although several state and local governments previously had enacted such bans.

claim_subject: Facebook post Says news stories referencing 322 and COVID-19 are proof cases are being “synchronized”
scientific_truth: The volume of media coverage and the number of local and regional government units around the world provide ample opportunities for cases or deaths to sum to any number. You can find this “connection” for any low three-digit number. A Google News search shows 322 isn’t even a particularly common tally.

claim_subject: 3 Nebraska Medicaid providers honored for serving patients.
scientific_truth: Gov. Pete Ricketts is honoring three Nebraska health care providers for outstanding service to patients within the state’s Medicaid program.

claim_subject: The reaction between metallic mercury and aluminum, which produces a dramatic chain reaction popular on YouTube science channels, is evidence that vaccines are not safe.
scientific_truth: A fascinating series of events, to be sure, but ones that are ill-suited for commentary on vaccine safety.

claim_subject: Rumors that Keurig coffee machines harbor bacteria have been circulating the web for years.
scientific_truth: Health Dangers of Keurig Coffee Machines

claim_subject: Mending broken sleep: Sleep apnea, the dangerous cessation of breathing during sleep, is being diagnosed more and more. A simple machine can bring refreshing relief
scientific_truth: This is an engaging article that may help raise awareness of sleep apnea and the types of problems it may cause. The presentation of a continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP) device as a non-surgical intervention that can be quite helpful is accurate, though a more balanced view would have included some discussion of the difficulties that many have in being...

claim_subject: Mainland China sees rise in new coronavirus cases.
scientific_truth: Mainland China reported 30 new coronavirus cases on Saturday, up from 19 a day earlier as the number of cases involving travellers from abroad as well as local transmissions increased, highlighting the difficulty in stamping out the outbreak.

claim_subject: The ratio of corporate profits to wages is now higher than at any time since just before the Great Depression.
scientific_truth: Robert Reich says ratio of corporate profits to wages is highest since before Great Depression

claim_subject: China sends medical supplies, experts to help Italy battle coronavirus.
scientific_truth: A planeload of medical supplies, including masks and respirators, has arrived in Italy from China to help it deal with its growing coronavirus crisis.

claim_subject: Spain overtakes Italy in coronavirus cases, death rate slows.
scientific_truth: Spain overtook Italy for the first time on Friday for the number of confirmed coronavirus cases, but the overnight death toll fell from the previous day, providing a small glimmer of hope.

claim_subject: Ohio county to distribute bags that deactivate drugs.
scientific_truth: An Ohio county is distributing bags that deactivate prescription drugs as part of the fight against the state’s opioid epidemic.

claim_subject: A nurse employed in a Zambian hospital swapped nearly 5,000 babies at birth and gave them to the "wrong" parents.
scientific_truth: "I am asking Zambians to forgive me for the evil things I was doing to innocent children."

claim_subject: Nurse’s kidney donation triggers bi-state transplant chain.
scientific_truth: A nurse’s decision to donate a kidney to a patient triggered a series of events that led to three people getting new organs at two Kansas City-area hospitals.

claim_subject: Warnings that Mcafee or Norton has identified the most destructive computer virus ever disguised as a Hallmark postcard email with the subject line “A Card for You,” “Virtual Card for You,” “Postcard” or a “Postcard from Hallmark” have been circulating for years.
scientific_truth: A Card for You, Virtual Card For You, or Postcard Virus Warning

claim_subject: Georgia board starts work on medical marijuana rules .
scientific_truth: A new Georgia board has begun working to create rules and a distribution network for the sale of medical marijuana oil.

claim_subject: Millions face risk from drug-coated stents
scientific_truth: Drug-eluting or drug-coated stents were first introduced in the U.S. in the mid-90s. Ten years later, they have all but replaced traditional stents because of their ability to prevent the clogged artery from closing again. However, new information suggests that these stents may in fact be causing some clots to form.

claim_subject: China toddler fights fat in land of little emperors.
scientific_truth: In a sleepy riverside village in Southern China, three-year-old Lu Zhihao tears around his home; his belly, arms and legs wobbling with fat as he stuffs a pear into his mouth.

claim_subject: Teenage environmental activist Greta Thunberg is actually an Australian actress named Estella Renee.
scientific_truth: It is possible to be both worried about climate-change and a child actress at the same time.

claim_subject: Influenza now in all Maine counties; considered widespread.
scientific_truth: Cases of influenza have been found in all 16 Maine counties and the disease is now considered widespread, state health officials said Wednesday.

claim_subject: Global coronavirus death toll hits 150,000: Reuters tally.
scientific_truth: The number of deaths worldwide linked to the novel coronavirus reached 150,000 on Friday, according to a Reuters tally.

claim_subject: Facebook post Says Italian Prime Minister Giuseppe Conte said, “We have lost control, we have killed the epidemic physically and mentally. Can’t understand what more we can do, all solutions are exhausted on ground. Our only hope remains up in the Sky, God rescue your people.”
scientific_truth: The quote attributed to Italian Prime Minister Giuseppe Conte is fabricated. The image accompanying the post shows the president of Brazil, not the Italian prime minister.

claim_subject: The death from influenza of eight mostly vaccinated people over 65 in California's Santa Barbara County during the 2017-2018 flu season proves that you shouldn’t get the flu shot.
scientific_truth: The fact is, unless you belong to a class of immunocompromised individuals, the flu shot is extremely safe but its effectiveness does vary year to year. Even in its least effective years, though, influenza immunization has been shown to reduce significantly the incidence of the virus at the population level, which ultimately means there will be fewer opportunities for someone...

claim_subject: Facebook post Says the governors of Michigan, New York and Nevada “have issued orders banning the prescription of hydroxychloroquine to patients with COVID-19.”
scientific_truth: New York and Nevada have restricted access to chloroquine prescriptions to avoid stockpiling of the drug. There are exemptions for clinical trials and patients hospitalized with COVID-19. Michigan has not taken any regulatory action related to chloroquine. Instead, it has asked prescribers to not give the drug to potential stockpilers.

claim_subject: As millions vape, e-cigarette researchers count puffs, scour Facebook.
