claim_subject: Can vitamin C prevent infection with coronavirus or prevent deaths from covid-19?
scientific_truth: Studies to date are inconclusive. There is no evidence that high-dose vitamin C infusions reduce the risk of dying from covid-19. A preventive effect has not been researched at all.

claim_subject: Does vitamin D prevent covid-19 disease? Does vitamin D mitigate the course of Covid 19 disease?
scientific_truth: Studies to date on the treatment of covid-19 cannot answer whether vitamin D can alleviate the disease. No studies have yet been published on a possible preventive effect.

claim_subject: Is plasma therapy for covid-19 effective in preventing deaths?
scientific_truth: The summary of studies to date leaves a range of possibilities open. Overall, the data from mildly to fatally ill patients do not demonstrate either a positive effect or negative effects. Serious side effects have not been sufficiently researched and cannot be ruled out.

claim_subject: Does treatment with cortisone-like drugs such as dexamethasone ensure that more critically ill patients survive Covid 19 disease?
scientific_truth: In severe or even life-threatening covid-19 disease, cortisone-like medications can save lives. In non-severe covid-19 disease, this has not been proven. Here, there is even evidence that mortality may be higher.

claim_subject: Can contact with holy water make you sick?
scientific_truth: Pathogens often live in holy water basins. However, whether the usual contact with holy water can actually make people ill has not been researched.

claim_subject: Can Echinacea protect against colds?
scientific_truth: Regular intake of echinacea extracts could possibly offer some protection against colds. However, the effect seems to be small. It is unclear whether the plant is also suitable for treatment. Study results on this are contradictory.

claim_subject: Can echinacea relieve the discomfort of colds???
scientific_truth: Regular intake of echinacea extracts could possibly offer some protection against colds. However, the effect seems to be small. It is unclear whether the plant is also suitable for treatment. Study results on this are contradictory.

claim_subject: Does taking LaVita promote health or physical and mental performance? (Reader inquiry)
scientific_truth: There are no studies that have directly tested this question.

claim_subject: Do dental care products with nanoparticles of hydroxyapatite help pain-sensitive teeth? And can they prevent caries or repair already affected, decayed tooth enamel?
scientific_truth: On these questions, we found only inadequate studies with no explanatory power. They cannot provide evidence for the claimed effects.

claim_subject: Can light therapy with light lamps relieve the symptoms of autumn-winter depression?
scientific_truth: Light therapy with light lamps may be able to relieve fall-winter depression. However, it seems to help only one in five affected people. It is unclear how long an improvement lasts. Long-term studies are lacking.

claim_subject: Does vitamin B3 protect against severe covid-19 events?
scientific_truth: We could not find any completed meaningful studies on this topic. Two ongoing studies are currently investigating the question.

claim_subject: Does taking coenzyme Q10 improve movement disorders in Parkinson's disease?
scientific_truth: Previous studies suggest that the intake of coenzyme Q10 does not tend to bring about any improvement in movement disorders typical of Parkinson's disease. However, this assessment is not well substantiated.

claim_subject: Does treatment with focused high-intensity ultrasound (HIFU) reduce abdominal girth?
scientific_truth: In a study with low significance, the abdominal circumference at the waist decreased by 1 cm after 3 months. In our estimation, this uncertain effect is very small or hardly visible.

claim_subject: Does sugar substitution increase the risk of developing or dying from cancer?
scientific_truth: Most studies on sweeteners such as aspartame and cyclamate find no clear link. However, they all have major flaws, so the question cannot be answered with certainty at present. We were unable to find any meaningful studies at all on other sugar alternatives such as erythritol and xylitol.

claim_subject: Does ozonated vegetable oil help against athlete's foot or nail fungus?
scientific_truth: We could not find any studies on these questions that we considered trustworthy.

claim_subject: Does ozonated vegetable oil help against vaginal fungus??
scientific_truth: We could not find any studies on these questions that we considered trustworthy.

claim_subject: Are health checks of symptom-free individuals (screening) effective in containing the pandemic?
scientific_truth: Fever measurement at the border, questioning about complaints, or regular corona tests for health care workers: so-called screening involves examining people without complaints for a possible infection. Whether this can slow down the pandemic, however, is not well established. It is also unclear how reliably the series of health checks can distinguish infected from non-infected people.

claim_subject: Does melatonin help against jet lag?
scientific_truth: The best available studies suggest that melatonin may be effective against jet lag problems. However, this assessment is not well supported.

claim_subject: Does sunscreen reduce the likelihood of skin cancer?
scientific_truth: Although sunscreen protects the skin from sunburn, it has not yet been proven that it can also prevent skin cancer. The existing studies contradict each other. The problem is that the studies often did not take into account whether the participants applied the sunscreen correctly and regularly or whether the sun protection factor was sufficiently high.

claim_subject: Are international travel restrictions and border health checks effective in curbing the spread of covid-19?
scientific_truth: It may be that travel-related control measures lead to a reduction in the "import" and "export" of infections across borders. It could also be that the number of infected people increases more slowly. Health checks at the border could also identify previously undetected infections - but whether this will put a real damper on the pandemic is certainly questionable.

claim_subject: Does hypnosis help with smoking cessation?
scientific_truth: As things stand, the effectiveness of hypnosis for smoking cessation has not been proven. The study results are partly contradictory.

claim_subject: Does denosumab (Prolia) reduce the risk of vertebral fractures in osteoporosis?
scientific_truth: The pooled results of studies to date show that denosumab reduces the risk of vertebral fractures more than a placebo. It may even be slightly more protective than single other osteoporosis drugs. It cannot be ruled out that discontinuing denosumab increases the likelihood of vertebral fractures again. The studies on this are contradictory.

claim_subject: Does discontinuation of denosumab increase the risk of vertebral fractures???

claim_subject: Does taking magnesium improve the symptoms of depression?
scientific_truth: The question has been investigated in only three small studies. These had several shortcomings and in some cases reached contradictory results.

claim_subject: Does focused ultrasound (HIFU) treatment reduce wrinkles and sagging of the skin?
scientific_truth: We did not find any conclusive studies. So whether HIFU has a visible effect is not solidly studied. However, there are reports of significant pain, redness and swelling.

claim_subject: Does a ketogenic diet help against cancer?
scientific_truth: To date, there are no well-done studies that have examined the effect of a ketogenic diet on cancer in humans. This involves eating little or no carbohydrates and sugar, but plenty of protein and fat. Experts take a critical view of "cancer diets" such as the ketogenic diet - they can also be dangerous.

claim_subject: Do curd compresses have an analgesic effect (e.g. for muscle and joint pain)? Do they have an antipyretic effect? Do curd compresses help breastfeeding women with lactation congestion?
scientific_truth: We could not find any conclusive studies on curd wraps. Whether the effect goes beyond a cooling effect is unclear.

claim_subject: Does deuterium-reduced water prevent cancer?
scientific_truth: We found only one study with prostate cancer patients comparing deuterium-reduced water with normal water. This small study has numerous flaws, so the results are not conclusive. We were unable to locate reliable studies on its use in other cancers or for cancer prevention.

claim_subject: Does deuterium-reduced water improve disease progression in cancer???
scientific_truth: We found only one study with prostate cancer patients comparing deuterium-reduced water with normal water. This small study has numerous flaws, so the results are not conclusive. We were unable to locate reliable studies on its use in other cancers or for cancer prevention.

claim_subject: Can a special mattress relieve nighttime rheumatism symptoms and thus improve sleep?
scientific_truth: During our research, we did not find any scientific studies on this. Therefore, we can not make any statement about the effect of special mattresses.

claim_subject: Do people with blood group AB have a higher risk of developing dementia?
scientific_truth: The risk of dementia appears to be similar for people of all four blood groups (A, B, AB, 0). This was shown by two studies that evaluated data from more than 9,000 affected individuals. The claim spread in the media that the AB blood group increases the risk of dementia is therefore unlikely to be true.

claim_subject: Does therapeutic dancing help people with Parkinson's improve their movement problems?
scientific_truth: Dancing could somewhat improve the movement problems of affected people. It is also possible that dancing performs slightly better compared to other movement exercises. Nevertheless, it does not seem to increase the quality of life noticeably.

claim_subject: Is it possible to reliably detect coronavirus infection based only on symptoms but without laboratory testing?
scientific_truth: So far, no symptoms have emerged from which a covid 19 infection can be inferred with certainty. The absence of certain symptoms also does not allow an all-clear to be given. Thus, it appears that symptoms such as coughing, shortness of breath or loss of smell are not suitable for making a diagnosis.

claim_subject: Are home coronavirus self-tests as reliable as tests performed by trained healthcare professionals?
scientific_truth: Whether self-tests from the drugstore or pharmacy provide as reliable results as a test by trained health personnel has not yet been investigated. Errors are possible when taking the sample at home. Things can also go wrong in transit to the laboratory. This can affect the accuracy of the test result.

claim_subject: Does biotin help with hair loss? Does biotin make hair grow faster?
scientific_truth: The number of studies dealing with the effect of biotin on hair growth is insufficient. According to current research, a positive effect has not been confirmed.

Cesarean sections are likely to be needed less often with inductions than with waiting. The use of a suction cup and forceps is unlikely to change much, if at all.

scientific_truth: The summarized results of studies to date clearly show that dietary supplements with omega-3 fatty acids do not protect against acute cardiovascular diseases such as heart attack or stroke. claim_subject: Can cosmetic products with caffeine for hair and scalp help against hereditary hair loss?
scientific_truth: Caffeine can penetrate the hair root and prolong the hair growth phase there - at least if the hair loss is hereditary (androgenetic alopecia). At least, this is what studies from the laboratory indicate. Whether caffeine shampoo or other cosmetic products containing caffeine help women and men with hereditary hair loss is not yet clear. Reliable research is still lacking.

claim_subject: Is music therapy with rhythmic training helpful for people with Parkinson's who have trouble walking?
scientific_truth: Music therapy with rhythmic training could help Parkinson's sufferers walk a little faster and more safely. However, the effect is unlikely to be very great.

claim_subject: Do preparations with unsaponifiable components of avocado and soybean oils (ASU) help against limitations and pain in osteoarthritis of the knee joint?
scientific_truth: There is evidence of minor efficacy of preparations containing avocado and soybean oil (ASU). They can probably somewhat alleviate movement restrictions and pain in osteoarthritis of the knee joint - at least in the short term. claim_subject: Do preparations with unsaponifiable components of avocado and soybean oils (ASU) help against limitations and pain in osteoarthritis of the hip joint?

claim_subject: Can taking chondroitin relieve osteoarthritis pain or improve mobility in the long term?
scientific_truth: In the studies conducted to date, chondroitin did not lead to any noticeable overall improvement in the symptoms of osteoarthritis. However, the results differ from one another in some cases. This limits their significance somewhat.

claim_subject: Does taking arginine benefit existing cardiovascular disease or does arginine prevent it from developing?
scientific_truth: We found only one small study that investigated a benefit that was noticeable for those affected. In patients with heart failure, taking arginine did not improve exercise tolerance or quality of life. Due to a lack of details, we cannot conclusively assess how reliable these results are. Therefore, we cannot make any statements on the benefit of arginine.

claim_subject: Does "Detoxic" work against tapeworms and other parasites? Does "Detoxic" help with health complaints?
scientific_truth: There are no published studies on "Detoxic". The claimed effects cannot be verified and seem frivolous.

claim_subject: Is mannose as good as or better than antibiotics for preventing recurrent cystitis?
scientific_truth: In two studies, bladder infections occurred with a similar frequency or even less frequently with mannose than with an antibiotic. However, the studies are so poorly done that the results are not trustworthy.

claim_subject: Does taking vitamin K lower the risk of spinal fractures in older women?
scientific_truth: Taking vitamin K probably does not reduce the risk of vertebral fractures. However, this assessment is not well supported. The risk of other bone fractures could possibly be reduced - but only slightly. This estimate is also subject to some uncertainty.

claim_subject: Does taking vitamin K lower the risk of other bone fractures in older women?
scientific_truth: Taking vitamin K probably does not reduce the risk of vertebral fractures. However, this assessment is not well supported. The risk of other bone fractures could possibly be reduced - but only slightly. This estimate is also subject to some uncertainty.

claim_subject: Does Smartsleep provide better or more restful sleep?
scientific_truth: There are no studies on this dietary supplement. Whether Smartsleep has a positive effect on sleep must first be scientifically researched. According to the manufacturer, a clinical study on this is in progress.

claim_subject: Can supplemental tryptophan, taken as a dietary supplement or with food, help with depression?
scientific_truth: The amino acid tryptophan appears again and again as a possible treatment for depression. However, an effect could not be scientifically proven so far. Significant studies on tryptophan against depression are lacking.

claim_subject: Can Neuro-Socks relieve pain or improve balance and stability?
scientific_truth: There is no scientific evidence of such an effect.

claim_subject: Does taking blood pressure medication in the evening prevent more heart attacks, strokes, and other acute cardiovascular diseases?
scientific_truth: According to two large studies, taking antihypertensive drugs in the evening should significantly reduce the risk of heart attacks, strokes and similar acute cardiovascular diseases compared with taking them in the morning. However, the described effect is on the one hand rather uncertain and on the other hand not very plausible.

claim_subject: In Covid-19, do nicotine or smoking have a protective effect, i.e., do they prevent severe progression or death?
scientific_truth: An observational study from a Paris hospital cited in many media is not suitable to support this hypothesis. On the contrary, according to the current state of knowledge, it is plausible that smokers could have an increased risk with Covid-19. They may be more likely to have a severe course of corona infection, necessitating ventilation or death.

claim_subject: Can red mold rice products lower blood cholesterol levels?
scientific_truth: Red mold rice naturally contains the substance lovastatin, which acts as a cholesterol-lowering agent. The concentration of lovastatin in products made from red mold rice can vary greatly. Therefore, it is not certain that red mold rice is as effective as drugs containing a controlled amount of lovastatin.

claim_subject: Do products made from red mold rice have fewer side effects than cholesterol-lowering drugs called statins???

claim_subject: Can disinfectants containing highly diluted sodium hypochlorite (below 0.1%) render corona and other viruses harmless and thus protect against infection?
scientific_truth: Whether disinfectants containing sodium hypochlorite reliably rid hands of viruses has never been investigated in scientific studies. However, studies on the disinfection of surfaces suggest: The low concentration of sodium hypochlorite may not be sufficient for reliable disinfection of hands.

claim_subject: Does cat's claw improve joint disease symptoms?
scientific_truth: We found three small studies that investigated cat's claw in patients with rheumatoid arthritis or osteoarthritis. The studies have significant flaws and sometimes come to contradictory results. Therefore, the question cannot be answered unequivocally.

claim_subject: Do essential oils protect against corona infections and other viral infections like colds or flu?
scientific_truth: In laboratory tests, some essential oils can successfully kill viruses. Whether spraying, inhaling or swallowing the oils also protects against infections with viruses such as the Corona virus in real life is unclear. It has not been scientifically studied yet.

claim_subject: Do air purifiers help relieve symptoms of allergic asthma?
scientific_truth: In our literature search, we found no evidence that air purifiers can help control allergic asthma. According to previous studies, they are unlikely to filter enough allergenic substances from indoor air to relieve symptoms or reduce medication.

claim_subject: Is special baby water better for infants than tap water?
scientific_truth: Whether special baby water is healthier for infants than tap water has not been scientifically studied. In principle, however, tap water in Austria is also suitable for babies. Boiling tap water is no longer necessary after the sixth month of life.

claim_subject: Does platelet-rich plasma therapy (autologous blood therapy) reduce pain in osteoarthritis of the knee joint?
scientific_truth: Injections with platelet-rich plasma could slightly reduce pain in osteoarthritis of the knee. The therapy is apparently more effective than placebo treatment, but the effect is small. For the hip, on the other hand, studies tend to point toward no efficacy. Local side effects are common.

claim_subject: Does platelet-rich plasma therapy (autologous blood therapy) reduce pain in osteoarthritis of the hip joint???
scientific_truth: Injections with platelet-rich plasma could slightly reduce pain in osteoarthritis of the knee. The therapy is apparently more effective than placebo treatment, but the effect is small. For the hip, on the other hand, studies tend to point toward no efficacy. Local side effects are common.

claim_subject: Can vitamin D supplements prevent colds, flu, colds, and other viral respiratory illnesses when there is no or only a mild deficiency of vitamin D?
scientific_truth: Taking vitamin D probably has no preventive effect against infections with cold, cold and flu viruses. This is true at least for people with normal or moderately low levels of vitamin D in their blood. If there is a severe deficiency, however, the immune system is likely to benefit from treatment with vitamin D.

claim_subject: Does ACE inhibitors like ramipril increase the risk of lung cancer?
scientific_truth: A large observational study has found an increased risk of lung cancer with long-term use of ACE inhibitors compared with another group of antihypertensive drugs. However, other causes for this association cannot be completely ruled out. Previous studies have reached inconsistent results.

claim_subject: Does propolis have a preventive or soothing effect against infection with coronavirus, colds or flu?
scientific_truth: To date, there are no studies that have investigated the effect of propolis in these viral infections.

scientific_truth: Drip-feeding high-dose atropine for 1-3 years probably inhibits the progression of myopia in the short term. If dripping is done daily, the effect does not seem to be noticeable 1 year after the end of treatment. If dripping is done monthly at first and then every 2 months, the effect is likely to last longer.

claim_subject: Is quarantining persons who have had contact with infected persons or who enter from high-risk areas an effective measure to reduce the number of COVID-19 infections and deaths?
scientific_truth: The analysis of 29 studies suggests that quarantine can prevent COVID-19 infections and deaths. The validity of the studies to date is diminished by the fact that only mathemathic modeling studies are available for coronavirus.

claim_subject: Can homeopathic globules protect against infection with the novel coronavirus?
scientific_truth: There is no evidence that globules can protect against the novel coronavirus (SARS-CoV-2). Scientifically, this has never been investigated. However, studies on other viral diseases, such as the common cold, show: a curative effect of homeopathy has not been proven.

claim_subject: Does the osteoporosis drug teriparatide increase the risk of bone cancer as a side effect?
scientific_truth: The suspicion that teriparatide could cause bone cancer as a side effect is based on animal studies on the one hand. On the other hand, there are individual cases of bone cancer in people treated with teriparatide - although a causal relationship cannot be clearly proven here. Systematic studies of people treated with teriparatide could not provide clear results.

claim_subject: Can therapy with EMDR (Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing) alleviate the symptoms of people with post-traumatic stress disorder?
scientific_truth: Therapy with EMDR is probably more effective than no therapy at all for people suffering from the psychological consequences of a traumatic experience. Its effectiveness may be similar to that of exposure therapy. This is a widely established and well-studied form of psychotherapy.

claim_subject: Does EMDR work similarly to exposure therapy, another well-studied form of psychotherapy for the symptoms of post-traumatic stress disorder???
scientific_truth: Therapy with EMDR is probably more effective than no therapy at all for people suffering from the psychological consequences of a traumatic experience. claim_subject: Does filling with hydrogel help with chronic back pain caused by a worn disc?
scientific_truth: None of the studies to date can answer how well the treatment works - they lack conclusiveness for this. Some hydrogel products have since been withdrawn from the market.

claim_subject: Does taking hyaluronic acid in capsule form improve the symptoms of knee osteoarthritis?
scientific_truth: The question was examined in three small studies with various shortcomings. They come to contradictory results. Therefore, we cannot say for sure whether hyaluronic acid for oral use has a beneficial effect on the symptoms of knee osteoarthritis. We are also unable to make any reliable statements about possible risks on the basis of the best available studies.

claim_subject: Does taking chlorella provide better performance, more resilience and does it promote health?
scientific_truth: We have found only one very small study on this topic with completely unclear results. From this, we cannot derive any statements on the benefits and risks of dietary supplements from chlorella algae.

claim_subject: Does going to the sauna several times a week prolong men's lives?
scientific_truth: Men who go to the sauna several times a week live longer than those who go only once a week. However, it is possible that this is not due to the sauna at all. For women, the effect of sauna visits has not been sufficiently researched.

claim_subject: Does going to the sauna several times a week prolong women's lives???
scientific_truth: Men who go to the sauna several times a week live longer than those who go only once a week. However, it is possible that this is not due to the sauna at all. For women, the effect of sauna visits has not been sufficiently researched.

claim_subject: Does the additional offer of HIV self-testing cause more people to take an HIV test?
scientific_truth: Current research provides very strong evidence that the addition of HIV self-testing leads to more people taking an HIV test. Among others, people for whom testing at health facilities by professionals is not acceptable for various reasons also make use of this offer.

claim_subject: Can the combination of propolis, xyloglucan, gelatin and hibiscus (product "Utipro Plus") relieve the symptoms of cystitis or prevent cystitis?
scientific_truth: Three studies on the product "Utipro Plus" investigated the combination of these ingredients. However, statements on the efficacy cannot be made, as the studies have various shortcomings. We did not find any studies on the ingredients - used individually.

claim_subject: Does PEMF noticeably improve pain in osteoarthritis? Does the method improve mobility and quality of life in sufferers?
scientific_truth: Pain was investigated in eight small rather flawed studies. The studies arrived at widely divergent answers. In the studies with positive results, it is partly unclear whether the difference was actually noticeable for those affected. Quality of life and mobility were investigated in five and two studies, respectively - these were small and of little significance.

claim_subject: Does oil pulling promote dental health?
scientific_truth: Studies conducted to date have been poorly done and are not conclusive. Thus, they cannot answer this question.

claim_subject: Can injecting stem cells into the knee joint relieve pain and limitations associated with osteoarthritis?
scientific_truth: It is unclear whether stem cells injected into the knee for osteoarthritis have a curative effect. Possible side effects and dangers are also insufficiently researched.

claim_subject: Can an extract of Desmodium promote liver health or relieve other ailments?
scientific_truth: We found no conclusive studies on the efficacy of Desmodium - neither on liver health nor for any other application.

claim_subject: Does the balsam apple help against infection with the human immunodeficiency virus (HIV)?
scientific_truth: Laboratory experiments have tested how proteins from the fruits and seeds of the balsam apple Momordica behave against the human immunodeficiency virus (HIV). However, studies with humans are still lacking.

claim_subject: Does healing clay with the clay mineral smectite help when children have diarrhea?
scientific_truth: Healing clay with smectite could shorten a diarrheal illness in children by about one day. For healing clay with kaolinite or loess, the effectiveness is unclear.

claim_subject: Can healing clay help with gastritis?
scientific_truth: We could not find a meaningful study that scientifically examined this question.

claim_subject: Does the Indian spice paste Chyawanprash have a positive effect on adult health?
scientific_truth: There is a lack of conclusive studies on possible health effects of Chyawanprash. We can neither confirm nor deny a beneficial effect.

claim_subject: Does ginger work against breast cancer?
scientific_truth: So far, only isolated animal studies and experiments with cells indicate that ginger substances could favorably influence the behavior of breast cancer cells. Studies with breast cancer patients are lacking. Therefore, there are no data on the efficacy

claim_subject: Can Theta Healing help with physical ailments and mental problems?
scientific_truth: There are no studies that have directly examined the healing effects of Theta Healing. However, one experiment contradicts a basic assumption of the method: According to this, there is no evidence that increased theta brain waves occur in involved persons.

claim_subject: Does taking Bacopa extract improve memory performance?
scientific_truth: The question was investigated in several mainly properly done studies with more than 500 people. Overall, no significant positive effects on memory and attention were found. Since some of the studies arrived at very different results and the estimates were far apart, this clearly limits the significance of the result.

claim_subject: Do remedies containing the trifoliate fruit alleviate the symptoms of rheumatoid arthritis ("rheumatism")?
scientific_truth: We have evaluated two small studies. They suggest that taking trifoliate relieves some rheumatism symptoms better than a placebo remedy. However, these results are not well established.

claim_subject: Does thyme strengthen memory or prevent mental decline?
scientific_truth: We have not been able to find any studies that have examined this question in the context of human studies.

claim_subject: Does regular consumption of chia seeds reduce body weight, blood sugar levels or cholesterol?

claim_subject: Do heat patches that heat themselves or heat pads help with pain in the neck?
scientific_truth: Studies on the pain-relieving effect of heat pads and self-heating plasters are contradictory.

claim_subject: Do heat patches containing capsaicin help with neck pain???
scientific_truth: Studies on the pain-relieving effect of heat pads and self-heating plasters are contradictory.

claim_subject: Do heat patches help with lower back pain?
scientific_truth: Heat patches produce heat by means of a chemical reaction. They can probably relieve low back pain somewhat in the short term. However, this has only been investigated for complaints that have persisted for a maximum of 3 months... Heat patches with chili extract (capsaicin)

claim_subject: Does ginger help with period pain?
scientific_truth: Previous studies indicate that ginger can slightly relieve menstrual pain. However, due to deficiencies in their conduct, they are of limited value.

claim_subject: Can the state of health be assessed as reliably with a "cell check" analysis as with other diagnostic tests (for example, blood or urine analyses)?
scientific_truth: There are no studies in which the reliability and significance of "cell check" results have been verified.

claim_subject: Can carbon dioxide in mineral water and other sparkling drinks damage teeth or cause tooth decay?
scientific_truth: Whether the regular consumption of carbonated beverages (mineral water, sparkling soft drinks) damages the teeth more than non-carbonated beverages has not yet been researched.

claim_subject: Does bark extract from maritime pine (also: "pine bark extract") improve the symptoms of osteoarthritis?
scientific_truth: The question was investigated in three smaller studies. However, due to severe methodological deficiencies and partly contradictory results, no firm conclusions can be drawn from them.

claim_subject: Is brown millet effective in favorably influencing the course of the disease in rheumatism ("rheumatoid arthritis")?
scientific_truth: We could not find any studies on this topic; therefore, statements on the benefits and risks of brown millet in rheumatoid arthritis are not possible.

claim_subject: Are cannabis or substances derived from cannabis effective and safe anti-cancer agents?
scientific_truth: Reliable studies on this question are lacking.

claim_subject: It is not always possible to reduce elevated cholesterol levels to a healthy level with tablets and thus minimize the risk of heart attack or stroke. Does this succeed through additional injections with PCSK9 antibodies?
scientific_truth: Up to now, this question has largely been investigated in people who not only have elevated cholesterol levels, but also already suffer from cardiovascular disease. Do these individuals receive additional cholesterol-lowering medications in addition to

claim_subject: Do vaginal suppositories containing the active ingredient imiquimod cause precancerous stages of cervical cancer to recede or disappear?
scientific_truth: In the only study on this subject, treatment was successful in some of those affected. Since the study is flawed and only a few women participated in it, the significance is limited.

claim_subject: Is blue light treatment as effective as UV light or other established therapies for psoriasis?
scientific_truth: We have not been able to find any publication comparing blue light with established treatments (e.g., UV irradiation).

claim_subject: Does frequent consumption of potatoes increase the risk of dying from cancer?
scientific_truth: The summarized results of studies to date do not show an increased risk of fatal cancers. They also do not indicate that potatoes reduce life expectancy overall.

claim_subject: Does kombucha have a positive effect on health?
scientific_truth: There are no studies that have conclusively investigated the effect of kombucha in humans. In addition, it is suspected that in rare cases home-made kombucha can lead to liver disease or dangerous hyperacidity of the blood.

claim_subject: Is graviola an effective and safe treatment for cancer?
scientific_truth: Significant studies with healthy or diseased people are missing so far.

claim_subject: Does taking preparations with fenugreek extract improve sex life or satisfaction with it?
scientific_truth: We conclude that no robust conclusions can be drawn from the best available studies to date. We found only two smaller studies with serious methodological flaws. The calculated positive results are not very reliable.

claim_subject: Does disulfiram improve the effectiveness of chemotherapy for cancer?
scientific_truth: The question has been investigated in only two older and small studies in people with advanced cancer. The studies have severe methodological flaws and come to contradictory results.

claim_subject: Can binaural beats relieve stress or anxiety before surgery and medical treatments?
scientific_truth: Previous studies are not conclusive. Moreover, their results contradict each other.

claim_subject: Is a vegan diet healthier than a vegetarian diet?
scientific_truth: There is no evidence that veganism has advantages or disadvantages for health. Both a vegetarian and a vegan diet seem to slightly reduce the risk of cancer compared to mixed diets.

claim_subject: Is the risk of bacterial or fungal infection comparable when using menstrual cups or pads?
scientific_truth: Our statement is based on a solid single study. Further studies may provide even more clarity in the future.

claim_subject: Laboratory experiments indicate that leoligin and other substances from edelweiss have a medicinal effect. However, this has not been researched in humans.
scientific_truth: To date, no research has been conducted to determine whether compounds from edelweiss are effective and safe in humans.

claim_subject: Can a straight bar improve harmless tension and pain in the neck and back?
scientific_truth: To date, there have been no studies on the efficacy of straight-arm restraints when the pain was not due to serious illness or injury.

claim_subject: Are ultrasound examinations during pregnancy safe for the health of the child?
scientific_truth: In previous studies, routine ultrasound examinations have shown no adverse effects. There were no differences in size, weight, birth complications or malformations in the neonatal period. Later, there were no differences between more frequently or less frequently "sonicated" children with respect to development or skills such as reading, speech, arithmetic, vision, or hearing.

claim_subject: Can oregano oil relieve discomfort or disease?
scientific_truth: So far, there are no conclusive studies that have investigated the health-promoting effects of oregano oil. We do not know, for example, whether it helps against infections.

claim_subject: Are Bach flower remedies effective in helping with test anxiety?
scientific_truth: Three small studies indicate that remedies with Bach flowers against test anxiety do not help better than a placebo.

claim_subject: Can capsules with diamine oxidase alleviate or prevent symptoms of histamine intolerance?
scientific_truth: We found only one small study with insufficient power.

claim_subject: Does magnesium help with period pain?
scientific_truth: To date, there have been no meaningful studies examining this.

claim_subject: Does cannabis improve symptoms of Parkinson's disease, for example movement disorders?
scientific_truth: The question has been investigated in only two small studies of unclear methodological quality. While they do not suggest any positive effects on different movement disorders, one study gives evidence of a small improvement in quality of life.

claim_subject: Is the dietary supplement nattokinase effective and safe as a blood thinner?
scientific_truth: We could not find any conclusive studies on this issue. Therefore, it remains unclear whether nattokinase acts as a blood thinner and consequently prevents severe cardiovascular disease. Likewise, we do not know whether taking the enzyme is safe.

claim_subject: Is the Feldenkrais Method effective against pain and tension in the neck, shoulders and back?
scientific_truth: Studies conducted to date are too untrustworthy to answer this question.

claim_subject: Does an alkaline bath help with neurodermatitis?
scientific_truth: To date, there is no meaningful research on this.

claim_subject: Does birch water, also called birch sap, help with health problems?
scientific_truth: So far, there are no studies that have investigated this issue. Therefore, evidence for the effectiveness of birch water is lacking. The side effects have also not been researched.

claim_subject: Is oolong tea an effective way to lose weight?
scientific_truth: We have not found any studies on the subject. Therefore, we cannot judge whether commercial oolong tea helps overweight people reduce their weight.

claim_subject: Do Waveex and similar products reduce exposure to electromagnetic fields, for example when using a cell phone or smartphone?
scientific_truth: The alleged active principle of Waveex and other comparable products is not scientifically plausible. We also found no meaningful study that could provide information about a possible effect of the cell phone stickers.

claim_subject: Can ingredients in deodorants like aluminum salts cause breast cancer?
scientific_truth: Whether the long-term use of deodorants can lead to breast cancer has not been sufficiently researched. There is a lack of studies conducted according to strict criteria with people over a longer period of time.

claim_subject: Does the intake of black cumin improve the symptoms of asthma, e.g. shortness of breath?
scientific_truth: The question has been investigated in four small studies. Some of them have serious methodological flaws and come to contradictory results.

claim_subject: Do specially trained dogs reliably warn of dangerous hypoglycemia?
scientific_truth: There are some positive reports and pilot studies. However, larger, well-done studies are lacking. Therefore, it is not proven whether or which dogs reliably detect and report threatening low blood glucose levels. Also unclear: how often do diabetic alert dogs give false alarms?

claim_subject: Does taking proton pump inhibitors (PPI) increase the risk of bone fractures?
scientific_truth: The question has been investigated in many observational studies involving a total of around 800,000 people. These show indications that prolonged use of proton pump inhibitors may result in more bone fractures. However, it is not possible to quantify exactly how great the risk of PPI is. Presumably, the likelihood of bone fractures increases with longer use and higher dosage.

claim_subject: Can matrix therapy (also: matrix rhythm therapy) alleviate complaints of muscles and joints?
scientific_truth: Studies conducted to date are too deficient to answer this question.

claim_subject: Can hyposensitization by injections with allergy-causing pollen components help with hay fever?
scientific_truth: In the case of hay fever, hyposensitization with injections can probably alleviate the symptoms somewhat. However, there is still too little research on how long this effect lasts.

claim_subject: Can hyposensitization by means of drops or tablets administered under the tongue help with hay fever?
scientific_truth: Probably this form of hyposensitization helps to alleviate hay fever symptoms somewhat, but the effect is unlikely to be great.

claim_subject: Do Blushwood berries help against skin cancer?
scientific_truth: An active ingredient (EBC-46, tigilanol tiglate) isolated from blushwood berries is currently being studied. Results of an initial study with people who have cancer have not yet been published. We have not been able to identify studies of an anti-cancer effect of other extracts from the berries that are ingested.

claim_subject: Can relaxation exercises and a reduction in stress slow the progression of glaucoma?
scientific_truth: Studies to date are too deficient to answer this question.

claim_subject: Can dementia be prevented by years of orange juice consumption?
scientific_truth: The protective effect of orange juice on mental performance has been investigated in two large studies over several years. However, changes in mental performance are not the same as a dementia diagnosis. In addition: the studies came to different results, and chance findings cannot be ruled out. Therefore, the question cannot be answered.

claim_subject: Can remedies from papaya improve digestion or relieve gastrointestinal discomfort?
scientific_truth: Studies to date are too deficient to provide a meaningful answer to this question.

claim_subject: Are kinesiotapes effective for chronic non-specific lower back pain ("low back pain")?
scientific_truth: The efficacy of kinesiotaping in relation to non-specific chronic low back pain ("low back pain") has been investigated in only a few studies. Overall, the evidence suggests that pain intensity does not decrease with kinesiotapes any more than with a placebo tape; thus, the tapes may not be effective. However, this preliminary finding is not well supported.

claim_subject: Does early detection of lung cancer by trained sniffer dogs provide significant benefits to those affected?
scientific_truth: Experiments indicate that some dogs can detect lung cancer from human breath samples. But we cannot say whether screening with specially trained dogs provides tangible benefits to those affected, such as preventing deaths or enabling gentler treatment.

claim_subject: Do snoring sprays or gargle solutions help against snoring?
scientific_truth: Three smaller studies with methodological flaws come to contradictory conclusions.

claim_subject: Does Maca help with sexual problems such as erectile dysfunction or sexual aversion in men and women?
scientific_truth: Studies to date are too deficient to provide a meaningful answer to this question.

claim_subject: Can glacier milk powder prevent hangover or relieve hangover symptoms?
scientific_truth: To date, there are no studies that have investigated this issue. There is no evidence of efficacy; side effects have also not been studied.

claim_subject: Can ingredients from pomegranate lower elevated blood pressure or reduce the risk of cardiovascular disease?
scientific_truth: Previous studies are poor and not conclusive enough to answer this question.

claim_subject: Does regular consumption of red meat or processed meat products increase the risk of colorectal cancer?
scientific_truth: People who regularly eat a lot of red meat or processed meat products such as sausage, ham and bacon are likely to have a slightly higher risk of colorectal cancer than people who eat little meat.

claim_subject: Does stool transplantation help with ulcerative colitis?
scientific_truth: In ulcerative colitis, stool transplantation could reduce symptoms for at least 8 weeks. Whether the method also helps in the long term has not been sufficiently researched. We have not found any conclusive studies on Crohn's disease.

claim_subject: Does stool transplantation help in Crohn's disease???
scientific_truth: In ulcerative colitis, stool transplantation could reduce symptoms for at least 8 weeks. Whether the method also helps in the long term has not been sufficiently researched. We have not found any conclusive studies on Crohn's disease.

claim_subject: Can remedies from the iambul tree improve blood glucose control in diabetes or precursors of diabetes ("pre-diabetes")?
scientific_truth: We were able to identify four studies that investigated the benefit of preparations from the iambul tree ( Syzygium cumini ) in people with diabetes. Because the studies are very small, had very few participants, and are partially contradictory, no firm conclusions can be drawn.

claim_subject: Does HPV vaccination reduce the risk of cervical cancer in girls?
scientific_truth: HPV vaccination reduces the risk of abnormal tissue changes (of grade CIN2 and higher) on the cervix, which can later develop into cancer. Thus, the risk of later developing cervical cancer probably also decreases. However, the vaccination does not provide complete protection because it is not effective against all cancer-causing human papilloma viruses (HPV).

claim_subject: Is stool transplantation effective against recurrent Clostridium difficile infections ?
scientific_truth: So far, only a few studies have been conducted with humans. These have various shortcomings. Nevertheless, there is evidence that stool transplantation is effective.

claim_subject: Does the juice of the aronia berry help against cystitis?
scientific_truth: The aronia berry is said to have various positive effects. For example, its juice is said to have a preventive effect against bladder infections. However, we could not find any conclusive studies on this topic.

claim_subject: Is Intermittent Fasting suitable for reducing excess weight as well as a conventional low calorie diet?
scientific_truth: Intermittent fasting (also: intermittent fasting) is probably effective for losing weight. In terms of weight reduction, there are probably no clear differences from a conventional diet in which calories are permanently reduced. Both paths can lead to weight reductions that are significant for health.

claim_subject: Is the risk for the brain inflammation SSPE as a consequence of measles disease greater than long assumed? That is, out of every 100,000 people infected with measles, does more than one person develop SSPE (subacute sclerosing panencephalitis) later in life?
scientific_truth: The risk for the fatal brain infection SSPE appears to be significantly higher than the estimate of one SSPE case per 100,000 measles cases in Germany, the United Kingdom, and the United States. To calculate the risk more accurately, more reliable long-term recording of measles infections and SSPE cases would be needed.

claim_subject: Can acupuncture for labor induction trigger the onset of labor?
scientific_truth: The results of previous studies suggest that acupuncture is not effective for induction of labor.

claim_subject: Can switching to a higher fiber diet prevent colorectal cancer?
scientific_truth: According to previous studies, regular intake of wheat bran or psyllium husks over a period of up to four years does not appear to be able to reduce the risk of colorectal precancer and colorectal cancer. This also applies to a comprehensive change to a high-fiber diet.

claim_subject: Can perineal massage during pregnancy help prevent birth injury in first-time mothers?
scientific_truth: The study evidence to date shows that perineal birth injuries are likely to be somewhat reduced in the group of women having a baby for the first time. This is due in particular to the fact that fewer perineal incisions were performed. The positive effect could not be shown for women who had already had a vaginal delivery.

claim_subject: Can cancer be effectively treated with vitamin C infusions?
scientific_truth: Studies conducted to date are deficient and inconclusive.

claim_subject: Are detox cures good for health?
scientific_truth: The term "detox" is not clearly defined. Therefore, we did not find any studies that investigated a health effect.

claim_subject: Do sweeteners increase the risk of type 2 diabetes or sugar metabolism disorders?
scientific_truth: The question has been investigated in several large population studies with long observation periods. Nevertheless, no clear conclusion can be drawn: the best estimates cautiously suggest a small effect. However, it could easily be due to other influences. Another problem is that most of the studies only examined sodas and other beverages containing sweeteners.

claim_subject: Does flu vaccination reduce the likelihood of getting the flu (influenza)?
scientific_truth: Flu vaccination is likely to protect adults from influenza. In studies on this, 2.3 percent of participants fell ill without vaccination. With vaccination, the figure was 0.9 percent.

claim_subject: Can therapy with the radioactive gas radon noticeably alleviate pain in rheumatism-related joint inflammation (rheumatoid arthritis)?
scientific_truth: In two small studies, a course of radon therapy relieved pain so slightly within six months that the effect was probably not noticeable.

claim_subject: Does frankincense help with painful joint wear (osteoarthritis)?
scientific_truth: Taking frankincense capsules may improve joint pain somewhat. However, this still needs to be confirmed by larger, better conducted studies.

claim_subject: Does the extract of the plant Salacia reticulata in combination with vitamin D ("Exadipin") help to lose weight?
scientific_truth: There are no conclusive studies that have investigated this effect.

claim_subject: Does yoga reduce the impairment in everyday life caused by persistent (chronic) back pain?
scientific_truth: With yoga, after six months, sufferers are likely to feel somewhat less affected by their back pain and be able to "function" better in everyday life. However, it seems that the pain itself is not noticeably weakened by the yoga sessions.

claim_subject: Does yoga alleviate the severity of persistent back pain???

claim_subject: Do laughter yoga or laughter therapy have positive health effects?
scientific_truth: There are some studies on the subject. But these are unfortunately not conclusive. After evaluating five smaller studies, we can therefore neither speak for nor against the existence of a positive health effect of laughter yoga or laughter therapy.

claim_subject: Can a height-adjustable desk reduce sitting time in the office?
scientific_truth: There is evidence that people with height-adjustable desks could reduce sitting by about 100 minutes per workday in the short term. Whether the effect lasts in the long term has not been studied. We have separately researched the extent to which a reduction in sitting time can contribute to better health.

claim_subject: Does a diet that includes as many organic foods as possible lower the risk of cancer?
scientific_truth: To date, only two studies have been published that have explored a possible link between the consumption of organic products and cancer risk. Both publications have methodological flaws. Moreover, they contradict each other: One suggests that people with higher organic consumption are less likely to develop cancer, while the second study found no differences between organic and conventional diets.

claim_subject: Does cinnamon lower blood sugar levels in diabetes?
scientific_truth: The pooled results of studies to date indicate that cinnamon is unlikely to affect blood glucose levels in diabetic patients.

claim_subject: Does sitting for long periods shorten the lifespan?
scientific_truth: According to the summarized results of previous studies, people live shorter if they sit for nine hours or per day. However, it is not well established that sitting for long periods is really to blame for premature deaths.

claim_subject: Does mammography screening reduce the risk of dying from breast cancer in certain age groups?
scientific_truth: According to a large systematic review, participation in mammography screening in women between 50 and 69 is likely to prevent a few deaths from breast cancer. Whether mammography screening reduces breast cancer mortality in women younger than 50 years has not been proven with certainty.

claim_subject: Should wisdom teeth that have not or not completely grown out of the jaw and gums be removed as a precaution? Even if the "impacted" teeth are not causing any symptoms at the moment and no pathological changes are to be expected immediately?
scientific_truth: According to current knowledge, there is no answer as to whether the precautionary removal of impacted wisdom teeth helps to prevent problems later in life. It is therefore unclear how to deal with these last molars if they do not protrude or only partially protrude from the jaw and gums, are free of signs of disease and do not damage...

claim_subject: Do turmeric preparations alleviate the symptoms of knee osteoarthritis ("joint wear") better than a placebo?
scientific_truth: Effects of turmeric on pain and mobility have been investigated in several small studies. However, these had few test subjects, poor methodological quality and varied results. Therefore, no reliable statements can be made.,We cannot make any reliable assessment of the efficacy of turmeric against pain and for improving mobility.

claim_subject: Do turmeric preparations relieve the symptoms of rheumatoid arthritis ("rheumatism") better than a placebo or painkiller???

claim_subject: Does the intake of omega-3 fatty acids improve the clinical picture in multiple sclerosis (MS) or does this inhibit progression of the disease?
scientific_truth: Studies with a total of over 1000 participants found predominantly no benefit from omega-3 fatty acids. claim_subject: Does taking vitamin A or following certain diets improve or halt the progression of multiple sclerosis (MS)?
scientific_truth: Studies with a total of over 1000 participants found predominantly no benefit from omega-3 fatty acids. claim_subject: Can Botox injections prevent migraine attacks?
scientific_truth: According to studies to date, Botox seems to reduce the number of migraine days by two days per month. However, this only applies to severely affected patients who suffer from headaches for more than two weeks a month.

claim_subject: Does taking probiotics facilitate weight loss to any significant degree?
scientific_truth: The question has been investigated in a large number of studies. In summary, there is at most a small benefit over a maximum period of half a year, but this is probably not significant. Longer-term effects have not been investigated. Due to methodological shortcomings of most studies, no firm conclusions can be drawn.

claim_subject: Does the full moon have a negative effect on sleep duration?
scientific_truth: Some studies can be found that have investigated the influence of the moon on sleep. However, they are not very conclusive. In sum, they do not indicate that people sleep shorter on nights around the full moon than around the new moon.

claim_subject: Can lemon juice prevent or effectively treat gastrointestinal illness caused by norovirus?
scientific_truth: There are no studies that have investigated the effect of lemon juice on gastrointestinal infections caused by norovirus. It is therefore unclear whether lemon juice is suitable for disinfection, prevention or treatment.

claim_subject: For knee osteoarthritis, does rubbing DMSO into the knee bring less pain and more mobility than rubbing a placebo?
scientific_truth: Reliable studies have found no difference between DMSO and a placebo. However, there are still some uncertainties.

claim_subject: In case of osteoarthritis of the knee, does rubbing DMSO bring less pain and more mobility than the recognized painkiller diclofenac???
scientific_truth: Reliable studies have found no difference between DMSO and a placebo. However, there are still some uncertainties.

claim_subject: Does taking vitamin D improve symptoms in the most common form of psoriasis?
scientific_truth: Three smaller studies have found no benefit of vitamin D in psoriasis beyond that seen with placebo,The question has been investigated in many small studies, some with serious methodological flaws. The majority of studies have failed to find a benefit of omega-3 fatty acids from fish oil in psoriasis compared to placebo.

claim_subject: Does taking fish oil with omega-3 fatty acids improve the symptoms of various forms of psoriasis more than a placebo???

claim_subject: Does following a Mediterranean diet decrease the likelihood of cardiovascular disease in people at high risk?
scientific_truth: People who follow this traditional diet from the Mediterranean region are probably less likely to suffer a heart attack or stroke. However, the Mediterranean diet does not seem to prolong life.,According to a study with a small number of people, a Mediterranean diet could reduce the risk of fatal cardiovascular disease. However, further studies must first confirm this.

claim_subject: Does the probability of dying from cardiovascular disease decrease in people who have already had a heart attack?
scientific_truth: People who follow this traditional diet from the Mediterranean region are probably less likely to suffer a heart attack or stroke. However, the Mediterranean diet does not seem to prolong life.,According to a study with a small number of people, a Mediterranean diet could reduce the risk of fatal cardiovascular disease. However, further studies must first confirm this.

claim_subject: Does Grander water have health benefits compared to untreated drinking water?
scientific_truth: The alleged active principle of Grander Water is not scientifically plausible. There are also no clinical studies on the health effect to be found. Other studies usually find no difference between Grander water and untreated water.

claim_subject: Does astaxanthin protect against cardiovascular disease, cancer or prolong life?
scientific_truth: There is a lack of meaningful studies on astaxanthin. There are only studies that have recorded certain blood values or other surrogate variables for cardiovascular diseases, which on top of that could not find any benefit for the pink dye.

claim_subject: Do products from the noni fruit promote health?
scientific_truth: To date, there are no scientifically well-conducted studies that can prove a health benefit of noni.

claim_subject: Can spending time at waterfalls on a regular basis provide lasting improvement in asthma symptoms?
scientific_truth: So far, only one study has examined this question. However, it cannot provide an answer; the deficiencies in implementation are too great.

claim_subject: Does goji help with serious diseases like cancer or prevent heart attacks?
scientific_truth: There are some smaller studies with different goji preparations on various health issues such as cancer, diabetes, strengthening of the immune system or age-related macular degeneration. However, no reliable statements about noticeable effects of the goji berry can be derived from them.

claim_subject: Are amla supplements effective and safe in lowering high cholesterol?
scientific_truth: There are some studies with human test subjects. But the list of flaws is long, and the results of the studies are therefore not trustworthy. Thus, dietary supplements with Amla are not an alternative for proven effective therapies.

claim_subject: Does inhaling hive air have health benefits for asthma, allergies or other conditions?
scientific_truth: There is no scientific research that speaks for or against such a health effect.

claim_subject: Can chlorinated water from baby swimming cause asthma or allergies later in childhood?
scientific_truth: Studies conducted to date are too inconclusive and contradictory to make concrete scientific statements.

claim_subject: Is a lot of sunlight in childhood and adolescence a cause of age-related macular degeneration?
scientific_truth: Whether sunlight is (a) cause for age-related macular degeneration cannot be answered seriously at present. The quality of the existing studies is too poor. Regarding the question whether sunglasses in childhood reduce the risk for macular degeneration in old age, corresponding studies are missing.

claim_subject: Does wearing sunglasses in childhood and adolescence protect against macular degeneration in old age???
scientific_truth: Whether sunlight is (a) cause for age-related macular degeneration cannot be answered seriously at present. The quality of the existing studies is too poor. Regarding the question whether sunglasses in childhood reduce the risk for macular degeneration in old age, corresponding studies are missing.

claim_subject: Does water from jugs with semi-precious stones have a positive health effect?
scientific_truth: No studies are available on this. An effect is not plausible.

claim_subject: Is calcium from Japanese coral safe and effective in preventing disease?
scientific_truth: There are no well-done studies with human subjects that have investigated the efficacy and safety of dietary supplements containing coral calcium.

claim_subject: Does the observance of feng shui design rules help against bad sleep?
scientific_truth: Sleep hygiene recommends designing bedrooms so that their occupants feel comfortable. We were not able to find out whether designing the bedroom according to the rules of Feng Shui or leaving out mirrors opposite the bed plays a role in this. Corresponding studies are lacking.

claim_subject: Does taking vitamin C prevent motion sickness?
scientific_truth: We found only one small study with methodological flaws on this question. The study investigated a very specific question and shows contradictory results.

claim_subject: Do Lifewave patches improve health or athletic and mental performance?
scientific_truth: There are no trustworthy, comprehensibly conducted studies that suggest or even prove such an effect. The fact that the patches help is not plausible anyway.

claim_subject: Are there differences in hair removal effectiveness between IPL and diode laser?
scientific_truth: There may be no difference between hair reduction with diode laser and IPL. We have only been able to evaluate three studies on the subject with a few female test subjects; the studies had various methodological deficiencies. Therefore, our judgment could be revised in the future by better done studies.

claim_subject: Does carbonic acid cause cancer?
scientific_truth: Currently existing studies are too inconclusive to allow reliable conclusions to be drawn about the effect of carbonic acid on the digestive tract. However, there are indications that carbonic acid is unlikely to cause cancer. However, the underlying studies have only limited significance.

claim_subject: Does carbonic acid have any health effects on the digestive tract???
scientific_truth: Currently existing studies are too inconclusive to allow reliable conclusions to be drawn about the effect of carbonic acid on the digestive tract. However, there are indications that carbonic acid is unlikely to cause cancer. However, the underlying studies have only limited significance.

claim_subject: Does wearing compression stockings on a long-haul flight prevent thrombosis (blood clots) and the associated symptoms?
scientific_truth: In previous studies, compression stockings have significantly reduced the likelihood of symptomless thrombosis. This probably also reduces the risk of rarely occurring problematic thromboses that lead to serious symptoms.

claim_subject: Can extracorporeal shock wave therapy relieve heel pain if the cause is tendonitis or a heel spur?
scientific_truth: Shock wave therapy is likely to help relieve chronic heel pain - if it is caused by inflammation of the plantar tendon plate (plantar fasciitis) or by a heel spur. In many cases, the complaints also improve on their own.

claim_subject: Does an extract from the African black bean (active ingredient 5-hydroxytryptophan) help against lovesickness?
scientific_truth: Such an effect has not yet been scientifically confirmed.

claim_subject: Does a mixture of hops and other natural remedies help with sleep problems?
scientific_truth: As a single active ingredient, hops have not been well researched. Significant clinical studies exist only on mixed preparations containing the following agents in addition to hops: Valerian, unsaturated vegetable fats or processed milk protein in combination with an extract of Chinese date. Results of previous studies indicate that these mixtures cannot improve sleep.

claim_subject: Do hops as a single active ingredient help with sleep problems???
scientific_truth: As a single active ingredient, hops have not been well researched. Significant clinical studies exist only on mixed preparations containing the following agents in addition to hops: Valerian, unsaturated vegetable fats or processed milk protein in combination with an extract of Chinese date. Results of previous studies indicate that these mixtures cannot improve sleep.

claim_subject: Does taking a mushroom called reishi benefit cancer?
scientific_truth: The question of the effect of Reishi against cancer was explored in some studies. However, these were small and sometimes had serious methodological flaws. In addition, because a variety of cancers, treatments, and Reishi preparations have been studied, comparisons are difficult. Thus, the question of the anti-cancer effect of the mushroom cannot be answered reliably.

claim_subject: Can labor pain during childbirth be relieved by aromatherapy with lavender oil?
scientific_truth: Previous studies are poorly done, so their results have limited confidence. They suggest that aromatherapy with lavender oil might slightly relieve labor pain. Whether aromatherapy also shortens the duration of labor is not clear.

claim_subject: Can the duration of childbirth be reduced by aromatherapy with lavender oil?

scientific_truth: The summarized results of previous studies show: There are no diseases or complaints for which homeopathy has been proven to help better than a placebo.

claim_subject: Does toothpaste containing xylitol reduce the risk of caries?
scientific_truth: At least in children, xylitol in toothpaste in addition to fluoride could reduce the caries risk. However, reliability is limited by the small number of studies, which were only conducted under very similar conditions and have some methodological shortcomings. Studies on other xylitol-containing products are methodologically flawed and come to contradictory results

claim_subject: Do other xylitol-containing products (e.g. chewing gums, sweets, mouth rinses) reduce the risk of caries in addition to normal dental care?
scientific_truth: At least in children, xylitol in toothpaste in addition to fluoride could reduce the caries risk. However, reliability is limited by the small number of studies, which were only conducted under very similar conditions and have some methodological shortcomings. Studies on other xylitol-containing products are methodologically flawed and come to contradictory results

claim_subject: Are paper towels or electric dryers more hygienic after washing hands?
scientific_truth: Studies to date do not allow any clear conclusions to be drawn as to which method most reliably reduces the germ load on the hands. However, the number of studies is also rather poor, since the studies use very different methods and have various shortcomings.

claim_subject: Are soy foods risky for people with unremarkable, or subclinical, hypothyroidism?
scientific_truth: Based on the study situation, it is unclear whether foods from soybeans can worsen inconspicuous hypothyroidism in susceptible individuals to the point where symptoms occur. One study does provide some evidence in this direction. But more robust research is needed to better clarify the issue.

claim_subject: Does taking vitamin B3 prolong life?
scientific_truth: At present, only individual laboratory experiments on simple worms indicate that vitamin B3 could have a life-prolonging effect. Whether this also applies to humans is completely unclear; studies on this are lacking.

claim_subject: Can taking Ribose help with heart conditions such as heart failure, narrowing of the coronary arteries (coronary artery disease), or heart attack?
scientific_truth: Some studies do suggest that there may be a possible link between the intake of (D)-ribose and cardiac function. However, these studies are not very conclusive.

claim_subject: Are vitamins and minerals effective and safe in lowering cholesterol?
scientific_truth: Whether dietary supplements can lower cholesterol is still poorly researched. We have answered further questions in separate articles: Multivitamin supplements have not been shown to reduce the risk of cardiovascular disease. It is possible that fish oil capsules have a positive effect, but this must first be confirmed in well-done studies.

claim_subject: Is fasting effective and safe in the long term for arthritis and other diseases?
scientific_truth: It is unclear whether fasting has lasting positive health effects, for example in rheumatoid arthritis. Conclusive studies are lacking. Intensive research is currently being conducted in this field with its many aspects - better studies are in prospect.

claim_subject: Do green smoothies promote health?
scientific_truth: There are no studies on green smoothies. Neither about effectiveness nor about possible side effects can be scientifically proven statements.

claim_subject: Does chocolate have a mood-lifting effect?
scientific_truth: Chocolate actually contains many substances that can theoretically influence mood. However, they occur in concentrations that are too low for this. Nevertheless, the sweetness, the expectation and the "overall package chocolate" lead under certain circumstances to an - albeit short-term - improvement in mood.

claim_subject: Do sprouts or buds have a healing effect?
scientific_truth: A healing effect of buds has not been investigated in a single scientific study so far. There is no evidence that ingredients from buds can cure diseases.

claim_subject: Is belly fat or is a large abdominal girth particularly dangerous for health?
scientific_truth: Current studies suggest that fat deposits in the abdomen ("visceral fat˝) may increase the risk of premature death. It is possible that individuals with unremarkable body mass index are also at risk. In the coming years, new studies will probably allow a better assessment.

claim_subject: Can choline ingested with food - alone or in the form of lecithin, for example - improve memory?
scientific_truth: Studies conducted to date provide no clear indication of whether supplemental intake of choline leads to improved memory in healthy people or in people with dementia who are not choline deficient.

claim_subject: Does white sugar cause cancer?
scientific_truth: Studies on white sugar cannot be found, but a link between sugar in general and cancer has also not been established.

claim_subject: Do wound care products with sodium hypochlorite such as ActiMaris promote the healing process of wounds?
scientific_truth: We could not find any high-quality studies that investigated the influence of highly diluted sodium hypochlorite on the healing of chronic wounds. The same applies to fresh wounds and burns. Due to methodological deficiencies, the few existing studies do not allow a statement on efficacy or inefficacy or on possible negative effects of wound care with agents containing sodium hypochlorite.

claim_subject: Does the dietary supplement MSM help with osteoarthritis?
scientific_truth: There are indications of a possible positive effect of MSM in osteoarthritis. However, it is not very well proven to what extent these effects discovered in studies are also noticeable and sustainable in the everyday life of those affected.

claim_subject: Is wheat lectin, which is found in high amounts especially in whole wheat, harmful to health?
scientific_truth: There are no well-done long-term observations on healthy people from the general population. Therefore, there is a lack of robust data on the benefits and risks of a long-term diet without wheat lectin or whole wheat. However, that a varied diet with whole grains containing lectin protects against some diseases is relatively well established.

claim_subject: Is it harmful to health to regularly eat large quantities of fish contaminated with dioxins and polychlorinated biphenyls (PCBs)?
scientific_truth: Salmon and other river and ocean fish often contain traces of toxic dioxins and PCBs. However, too little research has been done to determine whether the amount of these toxins in regular fish consumption is sufficient to endanger health.

claim_subject: Is the DMPS test suitable to reliably indicate mercury poisoning?
scientific_truth: There are currently no well-done studies with reliable statements on the subject. So it remains open whether the DMPS test really benefits people who suspect heavy metal poisoning. However, risks of DMPS are known. All in all, this diagnostic tool therefore does not appear to be recommendable.

claim_subject: Can stevia lower high blood pressure?
scientific_truth: With all foods, "the dose makes the poison". As a sugar-free sweetener, substances from the stevia plant do not promote tooth decay and have no calories. A medical benefit beyond that may be an effectiveness against high blood pressure.

claim_subject: Is eating genetically modified corn a health concern?
scientific_truth: Several feeding studies in rats over short periods of time provide no clear indications of a health concern for various genetically modified corn varieties Whether side effects may occur over a longer period of time cannot be answered due to the lack of conclusive long-term studies in humans.

claim_subject: Are privately performed IgG tests to clarify food intolerances meaningful?
scientific_truth: Whether elevated levels of immunoglobulin G in the blood are actually signs of intolerance to certain foods is highly controversial. Studies in which people with intestinal diseases avoid specific foods provide no clear evidence of benefit.

claim_subject: Is a gluten-free diet recommended for people who do not have celiac disease?
scientific_truth: There are no well-done studies that have investigated gluten abstinence in people who do not suffer from the autoimmune disease celiac disease. Therefore, there is a lack of reliable data on the possible benefits of a long-term gluten-free diet in the general population.

claim_subject: Does the plant substance nobiletin contained in mandarins protect against weight gain?
scientific_truth: In genetically modified laboratory mice, the additional administration of nobiletin to a high-fat and high-sugar diet appears to be able to prevent obesity. Such an effect has not yet been studied in humans.

claim_subject: Does consumption of dairy products in middle and advanced age protect against bone fractures?
scientific_truth: Those who are 40 or older and consume a lot of dairy products do not seem to be able to reduce their risk of age-related bone fractures.

claim_subject: Is the milk of horn-bearing cows less rich in allergens and more easily tolerated by lactose-intolerant individuals?
scientific_truth: There is no well-done study that would provide conclusive scientific evidence to support these questions.

claim_subject: Does daily flossing protect against tooth decay, periodontitis and tooth loss?
scientific_truth: It is possible that regular flossing of the interdental spaces can help with mild gingivitis. However, there are no good studies that investigate whether this has a preventive effect against inflammation in healthy gums. The effect on the development of plaque is unclear.

claim_subject: Do protein supplements help build muscle?
scientific_truth: A lot of research is being done in the field. However, the studies often have methodological flaws and contradictory results. It is therefore currently unclear whether and in what form supplemental proteins can help on the way to a six-pack and biceps.

claim_subject: Does music therapy promote recovery from severe limitations of consciousness after severe brain injury?
scientific_truth: We have not found any high-quality studies that specifically investigate the effect of music therapy. Some scientists explored the influence of stimulation of the senses, in which acoustic stimuli are also used.

claim_subject: Can eating grapefruit in combination with some medications lead to harmful interactions?
scientific_truth: Yes, grapefruits can enhance the effects of some medications. However, the risk, type, and severity of side effects are only partially known, depend on the particular drug, and likely vary from person to person.

claim_subject: Can regular consumption of chocolate prevent cardiovascular disease?
scientific_truth: It is possible, but by no means certain, that chocolate could reduce the risk of developing cardiovascular disease such as heart attack or stroke. However, the high proportion of sugar and fat in most types of chocolate could also have negative effects.

claim_subject: Is barley grass good for health?
scientific_truth: Only one small study has tested barley grass extract in humans to date. Barley grass juice has not been studied. The foundations are lacking for a reliable statement.

claim_subject: Are diets with reduced carbohydrate content better for weight loss than other weight loss programs?
scientific_truth: There is much evidence to suggest that, in the case of obesity, low-carbohydrate diets lead to at least comparable weight loss over one to two years as fat-reduced diets or weight-loss programs with a balanced diet.

claim_subject: Does taking probiotics during pregnancy and early life protect children from atopic dermatitis?
scientific_truth: Current studies suggest that the intake of probiotics could counteract the development of atopic dermatitis. However, many questions about efficacy and intake remain unanswered.

claim_subject: Is Bulletproof Coffee recommended?
